title: Recapitulating neural tube morphogenesis with human pluripotent stem cells
protocol: Microfabricate PDMS stamps for use in the protocol (4 hours).
Micropattern glass-bottom dishes using fabricated PDMS stamps (2 hours).
Seed stem cells onto micropatterned glass-bottom dishes (2 hours).
Form a single lumen within the 3D epithelium created from stem-cell seeded dishes.
Expose cultures to TGFβ inhibition and BMP for neural development induction.
Nano-strip wafer at ~70°C for at least 5 minutes.
O2 plasma clean wafer at 375W for 5 minutes.
Dispense 4ml of resist in the center.
Spin coat at 300 rpm, 100 rpm/sec, for 7 seconds.
Increase speed to 500 rpm, 100 rpm/second, for 10 seconds.
Increase speed to 2000 rpm, 100 rpm/sec, for 30 seconds.
Let rest for 15 minutes.
Transfer wafer to hot plate at 65°C and ramp to 95°C over 10 min (3°C/min).
Transfer sample to hot plate for post-exposure bake.
Starting at 65°C, ramp temperature to 95°C over 10 min (3°C/min).
Dwell at 95°C for 5 min.
Develop in SU-8 developer until clear (~10-15min total).
Rinse with IPA and dry. A white film during IPA rinse indicates underdevelopment.
Repeat development process if necessary.
Clean sample with O2 plasma at 375W for 5 minutes.
Cure for 10 minutes at 180°C.
Inspect mold under stereomicroscope to verify micropattern dimensions.
Place fabricated wafer in silanization chamber for 30 min.
Pour a 10:1 ratio of PDMS and its curing agent onto the wafers.
Degas air bubbles in vacuum.
Cure at 65°C overnight.
Peel PDMS layer off the silicon mold.
Cut individual stamps out using a razor blade.
Drill a 20mm hole in the bottom of a 35mm petri dish.
Clean glass coverslip and 35mm dish using ethanol.
Apply a small amount of NOA-81 to the dish bottom.
Place coverslip on the dish.
Cure using UV light.
Prepare PLL-PEG at a concentration of 0.1 mg/ml in 10 mM HEPES (pH 7.4) on ice.
Sonicate PDMS stamps in ethanol for 10 minutes and dry with an air gun.
Place cleaned dishes and PDMS stamps in the plasma oven.
Pull a vacuum for 30-60 seconds in the plasma oven.
Allow a small stream of ambient air into the chamber using a needle valve.
Turn on radiofrequency power to full (18W) to generate a purple-hued plasma for 60 seconds.
Turn off radiofrequency power and pump. Vent slowly.
Place PDMS stamps in contact with glass.
Place R621 magnet on top of the PDMS stamp, place R821 magnet on the bottom side of the glass coverslip.
Use a 200 μl pipet tip to add PLL-PEG solution around PDMS stamps.
Incubate for 30 minutes.
Aspirate PLL-PEG solution and wash with PBS++.
Carefully remove PDMS stamp and wash with PBS++ two times.
Coat with a solution of Laminin-521 (5% v/v in PBS++) and incubate overnight at 4°C.
Wash micropatterns with PBS++.
Apply a fluorescently tagged protein for 10 minutes.
Wash the sample.
Observe in a fluorescence microscope.
Wash cultured hPSCs with PBS.
Aspirate PBS.
Add 200 μl ReLeSR per well and incubate for 2 minutes at room temperature.
Aspirate ReLeSR and incubate for 5 minutes at 37°C.
Resuspend cells in 1 mL mTESR per well.
Centrifuge cells at 180 RCF for 3 minutes into a pellet.
Aspirate media, and resuspend cell pellet into mTESR supplemented with 10 μM ROCK inhibitor. Final volume of resuspension should be 400 μl per well.
Pipet cell solution to form a single cell suspension using 1 mL pipette tip. Pipet up-down 10 times.
Pipet 200 μL of cell suspension into the center of prepatterned dishes. Allow cell suspension to cover the glass area by gently tilting the dish.
Incubate 15 min at 37°C in an incubator.
Add 1 mL of mTeSR1 per well and incubate for 10 min at 37°C in an incubator.
Aspirate excess media, leaving enough liquid to cover patterns and replace with fresh 2 mL of mTeSR1.
Incubate overnight.
Prepare neural induction media (N2). Combine 97ml DMEM/F12, 1ml N-2 supplement 100X, 1ml MEM-NEAA, 1ml Pen-Strep 100X, and 10μl β-mercaptoethanol 50mM.
Check seeded stem-cells on micropatterned regions to ensure they confluently cover the patterns.
Wash excess cells with PBS several times if necessary.
Supplement ice-cold N2 media with 5μM of TGFβ-inhibitor SB-431542 and 4% (v/v) ice-cold Matrigel.
Take out micropatterned dishes from incubator, aspirate the media, leaving some liquid to cover cells.
Mix 2 mL of N2 media supplemented with TGFβ-inhibitor and Matrigel.
Place the mixture into each well.
Return dishes to the incubator.
Check for lumen formation in brightfield on day 4.
Perform a media change on day 4.
Prepare 4% PFA in PBS-/-.
Aspirate media from dishes (don’t dry center) and immediately add 1ml 4% PFA to each dish.
Incubate for 1 hour.
Wash in PBS three times for 15 minutes each (in chemical hood).
Permeabilize in 1.5% Triton-PBS overnight at 4°C.
Wash samples in PBT three times for 5 minutes each.
Incubate samples in blocking solution (10% Normal Donkey Solution, 1% BSA diluted in 0.3% Triton-X in PBS) for 2 hours at 4°C.
Remove all liquid from the samples.
Incubate primary antibodies 1:100-1:200 in blocking solution for 1-2 nights at 4°C.
Wash samples in PBT three times for 15 minutes each.
Add secondary antibodies 1:500 in PBT and DAPI 1:5,000-1:10,000.
Incubate overnight at 4°C.
Wash samples in PBT three times for 15 minutes each.
Optional overnight wash in PBT.
Apply RapiClear to the sample.
Incubate for 30 minutes before imaging.
The samples are ready for imaging in a confocal or wide-field microscope.
For imaging in a light-sheet microscope, separate the samples from the glass dish by gentle pipetting.
